import sympy as s


t,Y,X=s.symbols('t Y X')

for i in range(3):
 for j in range(3):
  for k in range(3):
   n=9*i+3*j+k
   if n!=13 and n<=13:codes.append((i,j,k))
assert len(codes)==13
rows=[]
for i in range(13):
 for j in range(i+1,13):
  for k in range(j+1,13):
   q=[codes[i],codes[j],codes[k]]
   if any(sum(z[h]==1 for z in q)>1 for h in range(3)):continue
   for h in range(3):
    rows.append(('.'.join(''.join(map(str,z)) for z in q)+':'+str(h),(i,j,k,h)))
assert len(rows)==414


def val2(n):
 if not n:return 999
 n=abs(n);v=0
 while n%2==0:n//=2;v+=1
 return v


def e_coeff(code,t0,y0):
 i,j,k=code
 a=(i-1)*t0; c=(k-1)*y0; b=j-1
 A=a+c; B=b*(1-(i-1)*(k-1)*t0*y0)
 z=(1+t0*t0 if i==1 else 1)*(1+y0*y0 if k==1 else 1)
 if j==1:return(z*A*A,0,z*A*A)
 return(z*A*A,2*z*A*B,z*B*B)


def e_sym(code):
 i,j,k=code
 A=(i-1)*t+(j-1)*X+(k-1)*Y-(i-1)*(j-1)*(k-1)*t*X*Y
 return s.expand(A*A*(1+t*t if i==1 else 1)*(1+X*X if j==1 else 1)*(1+Y*Y if k==1 else 1))
